title: Chapter 440 Koba'S Thoughts
content:
Chapter 440 Koba'S Thoughts

At first, the beasts that rushed up were weak.

Wang Shuo could kill a large number of them with a sweep.

The beasts were as fragile as paper and fell in groups.

The top generals could also kill them instantly, and the slaughter was carried out recklessly on the plain.

This kind of hearty battle made countless generals extremely excited.

In several battles with monsters, they could only passively defend, and rarely had the opportunity to fight with such dense beasts in close combat.

The fight lasted less than 10 minutes.

The demon leader Koba, who was in unified command, saw that the situation was not right and immediately sent the elites of the demon tribe to attack.

Most of them were above the gold boss level.

The demon tribe led by Koba this time had a number of only more than 10 million, and the demon beast troops also had 2 million.

In terms of top combat power, he himself was a high-level general, and he had 7 monster bosses with the strength of intermediate generals under him.

The overall strength was already extremely strong.

Because the war on the western front was carried out simultaneously, the monster army was divided into three routes. The supreme commander, the monster king Rag, did not follow Koba to attack the Great Huai Territory, but went to attack Dongfang Ke.

The monsters had no idea that Wang Shuo had broken through to the advanced level.

In Koba's view, most of the warriors in the Great Huai Territory had entered the three-star secret realm, and the remaining advanced combat power was very rare.

Even if Wang Shuo broke through to the advanced level, he would not be afraid.

He should be able to deal with it, and he still had so many men.

He stood on the hillside and carefully observed the battlefield situation.

He decided to send a large number of cannon fodder to trap Wang Shuo and let him kill slowly, and wait until he was exhausted, and then he would do it himself.

At the same time, he sent his own general-level strength to annex this group of generals with good combat power under the Great Wall.

For insurance, he even sent 4 intermediate generals.

For these generals, the intermediate generals can definitely kill a large number of them with one skill.

The idea is very beautiful.

The intermediate general of the monsters, with a large group of ferocious monsters, rushed forward in a mighty manner.

But before the two sides fought.

The Hell Knights and top generals on the opposite side retreated.

Seeing this, Koba was very proud in his heart. The opposite side was indeed vulnerable.

So he ordered an attack on the city.

A large number of monsters began to join the siege team.

Under the command of Ayub, the soldiers defending the city began to fight back in an orderly manner.

The top generals came to the city wall, immediately put away the ropes they climbed up, and then joined the defense of the city.

Tung oil, rockets, rolling stones and other city defense materials quickly poured down.

Under the city wall, the screams of various monsters came one after another.

There was thick smoke everywhere, and the pungent smell of burning made people sick, but most of the soldiers had participated in the battle to defend the city and could barely adapt.

This time, Wang Shuo decided to accumulate enough anger first, and then kill the opponent's commander in one fell swoop.

In this way, the monster will collapse without a commander, and even if it does not collapse, it will be easier to deal with it without a strong commander.

As long as the anger is enough, Shura Slash will definitely kill the opponent's high-level general in seconds.

Moreover, Wang Shuo can also release the Ice Phoenix Emperor. Two high-level generals can deal with one at the same time, which will definitely be no problem.

This is also the reason why Wang Shuo has not released the Ice Phoenix Emperor so far.

At that time, a sudden attack will definitely be successful in one fell swoop.
